_README: Price table for the Budget Guard's pre-call estimates.
Entries with "last_verified": null are UNVERIFIED — the router REFUSES to make a
live (billable) call using one. Look the real price up in the provider's pricing
page/dashboard, put it in, and set last_verified to today (YYYY-MM-DD).
units: 'per_call' = flat USD per request. 'per_second' = USD x output duration.
Optional per-rate fields:
supports: [...]        -> the model's ACCEPTED input field names. The adapter sends
nothing outside this list, so an unsupported parameter is
never smuggled into a request.
usd_by / price_by     -> price varies by an input param (e.g. resolution tier).
price_expires         -> promo end date; the rate reads as UNVERIFIED from then.
params: {stage: {...}} -> per-stage input values ('all' applies to every stage).
identity_via_image     -> the model carries persona identity through image_url, so a
persona job must supply a reference still.
fixed_durations: [..]  -> model only emits these lengths; requests snap UP and are
billed at the tier. Omit for models billing by the second.
routing stages:
draft / final          -> the two video stages of the draft-then-approve gate.
still                  -> a NEW image from text alone: a face for a new influencer,
or a product/ad still. Cannot preserve an existing face.
still_identity         -> a new image OF AN EXISTING persona, seeded from their
locked reference. 10x the price of text-to-image, and the
only one of the two that keeps the face.

fal:minimax/h3-max/image-to-video.source: fal.ai/models/minimax/h3-max/image-to-video — schema and price read from the model page
fal:minimax/h3-max/image-to-video.price_note: promo launch rate, 50% off; reverts 2026-09-01 to 480P $0.05/s, 768P $0.08/s

runware:DRAFT_VIDEO_MODEL.source: TODO: verify at runware.ai — cheap i2v for a motion check

fal:fal-ai/flux/schnell.source: fal.ai/models/fal-ai/flux/schnell - '$0.003 per megapixel', billed rounded UP to the nearest megapixel. Our 720x1280 default is 0.92 MP -> 1 MP -> $0.003. Change image_size and this estimate is wrong.
fal:fal-ai/flux/schnell.price_note: text-to-image: creates a NEW face. It cannot reproduce an existing persona - use still_identity for that.

fal:fal-ai/flux/dev/image-to-image.source: fal.ai/models/fal-ai/flux/dev/image-to-image - '$0.03 per megapixel', billed rounded UP. Output size follows the INPUT image, so a large reference still costs proportionally more than this 1 MP estimate.
fal:fal-ai/flux/dev/image-to-image.price_note: 10x the text-to-image price, and still ~1/10th of a video render. This is the one that keeps an influencer's face.
